Update Element UI Descriptions

Source: R/el_descriptions.R
update_el_descriptions.Rd

Server-side update for el_descriptions(). The items themselves are markup, so replace them by re-rendering; this changes the settings around them.

Usage

update_el_descriptions(
  session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain(),
  id,
  title = NULL,
  extra = NULL,
  column = NULL,
  direction = NULL,
  border = NULL
)

Arguments

session

Shiny session; the current one by default, as for shiny::updateTextInput().

id

Component ID (un-namespaced).

title, extra, column, direction, border

New values; NULL leaves one unchanged.

Value

Called for its side effect; returns NULL invisibly.

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  # inside a server function
  observeEvent(input$narrow, {
    update_el_descriptions(session, "user", column = 1)
  })
}
